title: Frustration with reduced standard features and awkward usability
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe frustration with reduced standard equipment, limited choices, awkward changes between models, dealership support issues, and slow downshifts when overtaking.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention fewer standard features, hard or frustrating dealer interactions, changing controls or phrasing between cars, and delayed downshifts during overtaking.

undetermined.summary: One undetermined review compares the car unfavorably on interior choice and value versus another model, but the overall sentiment label is not resolved in the sample.

limitations: The topic mixes product features, dealer support, interface or wording changes, and transmission behavior rather than one single coherent issue.
Examples are few, so the sample is insufficient to judge how broadly any one complaint applies within the topic.
